content:
jas: Quick sync  interview with StraitLine finished. They gave a short hero line that'll work for the landing. Need signed permission + legal check.

toby: Hero candidate: "Redwood stabilized our inference tail and cut our per-request costs by ~35% in production." They prefer an embargo until 2026-04-12 09:00 PDT.

amy: I'll draft short + long case study, 3 socials, and a 30s highlight clip. Planning A/B hero test (tech vs impact) for first 48h.

nina: Legal asks: attach transcript + proposed attribution (name/title). If we use a percent, include baseline timeframe (90-day avg) or I recommend "~35%". Need signed permission PDF that references embargo lift timestamp. Quick turnaround if docs come today.

upload-bot: Transcript uploaded: /recordings/straitline-2026-04-02/transcript.v1.txt

toby: Attribution: "Evan Moore, VP Eng, StraitLine". They do not want email in the asset. I'll get the permission signed today.

rex: Lead routing plan: case study page -> HubSpot form variant -> set cs_source=straitline -> add to list webinar-invite-straitline -> tag `cs:straitline-hot` if RSVP clicked -> route to SF queue "CS - StraitLine". Add utm_campaign=cs_straitline_apr and cookie expiry 30d.

amy: Also add hidden field pipeline_channel=case_studies and include the short 30s audio clip for accessibility.

jas: Can we surface a CTA for webinar interest that auto-adds to a pre-qualification list? We want reps to invite top engaged viewers.

rex: Yes: workflow snippet:
```
Trigger: form submit (straitline-cs-form) -> set cs_source=straitline -> add to list webinar-invite-straitline -> if click RSVP -> tag cs:straitline-hot -> notify SF queue
```
nina: Please upload the signed permission PDF with exact quote wording, logo usage, headshot credit, and embargo timestamp. I'll redline and return by Mon 11:00 PDT.

toby: Signed permission uploaded: /permissions/straitline/permission-signed-2026-04-02.pdf

nina: Received. I'll review and post comments by Mon 11:00 PDT. If numerical language is borderline I'll suggest switching to "~35%".

amy: Draft ETA: first drafts into Drive by Thu EOD. Will include both hero variants and a short transcript excerpt.

jas: Action items:
- toby: confirm and upload permission (done)
- nina: legal redline + embargo clause (Mon 11:00 PDT)
- amy: draft assets + share link (EOD Thu)
- rex: HubSpot workflow + UTMs + SF routing (this week)

jas: Tagging @here for visibility :rocket:

upload-bot: Reminder: raw audio retained 90 days per policy.
